h1: Amazon listing optimization, from keywords to copy
overview: We review how your current Amazon listings read to shoppers and to search. We check keywords in the title and backend fields, the order of the bullets, the first screen of the description, the image set and the data fields. Then we rewrite what needs it and record old and new text so you can compare. Results depend on price, reviews and competition, so we focus on clarity and relevance rather than tricks.

faq: We cannot promise rankings, and anyone who does is guessing. We improve relevance and clarity, which are within our control, and we note what changed so you can judge the effect over the next weeks.
Do you use competitors' brand names as keywords?
No. Using another brand's name in your listing breaks Amazon's rules. We use generic and descriptive phrases that shoppers search for, and drop any terms that Amazon says are not allowed.
Will edits cause my listing to be suppressed?
We check changes against Amazon's style guide before saving, and keep a copy of every old version. If a listing is flagged, we restore or correct it straight away.
Can you change the product images?
We review them and plan the slots. Making new images is a separate service, listing images, which you can add. We never upload images that show claims you cannot support.
